hints.content:
Let's find the constant  of proportionality.   

In the proportional relationship between $m$ and $n$, one constant of proportionality is the number we multiply by $m$ to get $n$.

$m\, \times\,  ?=n$

$m$ | $n$ | Relationship
:-: | :-: | :-:
$3$ | $21$ | ${3}\times\blueD{7}=21$
$5$ | $35$ | ${5}\times\blueD{7}=35$
$8$ | $56$ |  ${8}\times\blueD{7}=56$

The constant of proportionality is $\blueD{7}$.  This means we can multiply $\blueD{7}$ by $m$ to get $n$.

Now, let's represent that as an equation.  

$\begin{align}
{n}&=\blueD{\text{constant of proportionality}}\times{m} \\\\
{n}&=\blueD{7}m
\end{align}$
